<b>Snitch Pick</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Striking an enemy with [[Clawline]] will cause them to drop [[Shell Shards]] and [[Rosaries]]. It has the hidden effect of also increasing Clawline damage.

== Usefulness ==
* The Snitch Pick makes the [[Clawline]] deal additional damage to enemies by granting a third additional hit that does damage equal to 0.25 times the Needle's base damage.
**In other words, when the Snitch Pick is equipped, the total amount of damage changes from the standard <math>(2\times0.50N)</math> present in the base Clawline to <math>((2\times0.50N)+(1\times0.25N))</math>, where <math>N</math> equals damage from the base Needle. The damage from the additional hit cannot be changed in any way except by upgrading the Needle.
*The third additional hit causes the enemy to drop some [[Rosaries]] and [[Shell Shards]]. The dropped Rosaries are subtracted from the amount that the enemy will drop when defeated, but the dropped Shell Shards are not.
** Because of this, the Snitch Pick is more helpful for actively farming Shell Shards than for Rosaries, though it can also be used to snag some extra Rosaries from enemies in passing during exploration. {{MissingInfo}}

== How to Acquire ==
Purchased from [[Grindle]] in [[Blasted Steps]] for {{R|740}} after acquiring the Clawline ability.
